goal: Move storage, save, ledger, money, and server services behind native runtime built-ins so one bytecode stream runs unchanged on the Python VM, the CPython extension, and the standalone executable
new_in_2_9_8: storage, save, fs, and file APIs lower to std.* syscalls and run in native C on both native engines
the save-path sandbox is enforced inside the CPython extension and the standalone executable, not only in the Python VM
ledger, money, server, and the SM CLI share the native syscall id table
the Python VM re-enters its legacy builtins from the syscall instruction on a VM-private bytecode copy, so the compile cache stays intact
native parity fixtures cover storage_core.mellow and ledger_core.mellow entry hashes
examples/native_server.mellow is the maintained native HTTP example served by mellow server serve
the workspace boundary gate rejects root build artifacts and undocumented native/ surfaces
runtime_notes: the encrypted save envelope (ChaCha20Poly1305 with HKDF) stays a Python service until phase 2
MELV standalone CLI hooks remain Python-side and are scheduled after the storage migration
green threads stay cooperative and explicit-yield based
runtime_policy: Native C is the release-authoritative runtime for v2.9.8 core work
default C execution must fail fast when native support is missing
release and CI validation should include native-only execution plus sanitizer/fuzzer gates
